improvements.protocol: Same 10000-record fixture; compare 20-row and 100-row pages, cold and warm caches; also compare reference and candidate query/runtime medians across 5 runs.
At least 5 paired runs of configure/filter/edit/export against a lawfully measured reference on the same fixture and hardware; candidate/reference <= 0.90 with no extra errors.
Every authorized write creates one attributable audit; undo restores exact previous existence/type/value; concurrent later writes are never overwritten.
Preview must cause zero mutations and show exact scope/count/diff; confirm changes only the previewed authorized rows.
Inject failure/cancellation after a checkpoint then resume; zero repeated commits, omitted rows or lost error records.

Keyboard and screen-reader walkthrough: visible focus returns to trigger, errors announced, all actions reachable; zero critical/serious automated defects; separately verify light and supported dark contrast.

release_matrix_notes: Version entries are target candidates, not executed combinations or a supported-version guarantee. README minimums are WordPress 6.5 and PHP 8.1. Owners must pin current supported integration versions and enumerate combinations before release acceptance.
